cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Hamming Weight (Number of 1 Bits)
description: Counts the 1 bits in the binary representation of n (popcount).
notes: 255 = 11111111₂ has weight 8.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Gray Code Rank from Binary
description: Converts n to its reflected binary Gray code n XOR (n >> 1), in which consecutive numbers differ in exactly one bit.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Luhn Checksum (Credit Card)
expression: mod(sum(k, 0, numdigits(n) - 1, if(mod(k, 2) == 0, mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10), digitsum(2 * mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10)))), 10)
description: Computes the Luhn (mod 10) checksum of a number that already ends in its check digit. The number is valid when the result is 0.
notes: Used for payment card numbers and IMEI codes. 79927398713 is the standard valid example. Numbers above 2^53 (16+ digits) lose precision; split longer numbers.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Luhn Check Digit
expression: mod(10 - mod(sum(k, 0, numdigits(n) - 1, if(mod(k, 2) == 1, mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10), digitsum(2 * mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10)))), 10), 10)
description: Computes the Luhn check digit to append to n so that the whole number passes the Luhn test.
notes: 7992739871 gets check digit 3.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: ISBN-10 Check Digit
description: Computes the ISBN-10 check digit from the first nine digits: weights 10 down to 2, modulo 11. A result of 10 is written X.
notes: ISBN 0-306-40615-2 has check digit 2.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: ISBN-13 / EAN-13 Check Digit
description: Computes the check digit of a 13-digit EAN / ISBN-13 barcode from its first twelve digits (alternating weights 1 and 3).
notes: ISBN 978-0-306-40615-7 has check digit 7.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: UPC-A Check Digit
description: Computes the 12th (check) digit of a UPC-A barcode from its first eleven digits (odd positions weighted 3).
notes: UPC 036000291452 has check digit 2 (leading zero omitted in the input).

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: ISSN Check Digit
description: Computes the check digit of an 8-digit ISSN (serial number) from its first seven digits, weights 8 down to 2 modulo 11 (10 is written X).
notes: ISSN 0378-5955 has check digit 5.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: GS1 Check Digit for GTIN-8
description: Computes the check digit of an 8-digit GTIN (EAN-8) barcode from its first seven digits.
notes: EAN-8 96385074 has check digit 4.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Mod 97 Check (ISO 7064, Numeric)
description: Computes the two ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 check digits for a purely numeric reference (the scheme behind IBAN checks).
notes: For 123456789 the check digits are 78. Letters in an IBAN must first be converted to numbers (A = 10, …), and the number must stay below about 9 × 10^13 here.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Sum of Multiples of 3 or 5 below n
description: Adds every number below n divisible by 3 or 5, by inclusion–exclusion with arithmetic-series sums (Project Euler problem 1).
notes: Below 1000 the sum is 233,168.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Count of Multiples of a or b up to n
expression: floor(n / a) + floor(n / b) - floor(n / lcm(a, b))
description: Counts the numbers from 1 to n divisible by a or b (inclusion–exclusion), e.g. how many "Fizz", "Buzz" or "FizzBuzz" lines a FizzBuzz program prints.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Sum of Multiples of k up to n
description: Adds k + 2k + 3k + … up to n, using the triangular-number formula.
notes: The multiples of 7 up to 100 add up to 735.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Sum of Even Fibonacci Numbers up to x
description: Adds the even Fibonacci numbers not exceeding x (Project Euler problem 2). Every third Fibonacci number is even.
notes: Up to four million the sum is 4,613,732.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Square of Sum minus Sum of Squares
description: Computes (1 + 2 + … + n)² − (1² + 2² + … + n²) (Project Euler problem 6).

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Sum of Digits of 1 … n
description: Adds the digit sums of all integers from 1 to n.
notes: From 1 to 100 the digits add up to 901.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Product of Digits
description: Multiplies the decimal digits of n.
notes: 39 → 27 → 14 → 4: repeating it gives the multiplicative persistence (3 steps for 39).

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Kaprekar Routine Step (Four Digits)
expression: sum(k, 1, 4, at(sort(list(mod(floor(n / 1000), 10), mod(floor(n / 100), 10), mod(floor(n / 10), 10), mod(n, 10))), k) * 10^(k - 1)) - sum(k, 1, 4, at(sort(list(mod(floor(n / 1000), 10), mod(floor(n / 100), 10), mod(floor(n / 10), 10), mod(n, 10))), k) * 10^(4 - k))
description: Arranges the four digits of n in descending and ascending order and subtracts. Repeating this reaches 6174 (Kaprekar's constant) within 7 steps, unless all digits are equal.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Palindrome in Base b Test
expression: sum(k, 0, floor(logb(n, b) + 1e-9), mod(floor(n / b^k), b) * b^(floor(logb(n, b) + 1e-9) - k)) == n
description: Returns 1 when the base-b digits of n read the same in both directions.
notes: 585 is a palindrome both in decimal and in binary (1001001001).

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Liouville's Constant (Partial Sum)
description: Adds 10^(−k!) for k = 1 … n; the infinite sum 0.110001000… is Liouville's constant, the first number proved transcendental (1844).
notes: Three terms give 0.110001; the next 1 appears at the 24th decimal place.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Hamming Distance between Two Integers
description: Counts the bit positions in which a and b differ (the Hamming weight of a XOR b).
notes: Used for error-detecting codes and to compare hashes. Works for non-negative integers below 2^53.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Total Number of 1 Bits from 1 to n
description: Adds the numbers of 1 bits in the binary forms of 1, 2, …, n.
notes: From 1 to 16 there are 33 one-bits in total.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Bit Length of n
description: Gives the number of bits needed to write the positive integer n in binary.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Next Power of Two
description: Gives the smallest power of two that is at least n.
notes: 1000 rounds up to 1024.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Two's Complement Encoding
description: Gives the unsigned w-bit pattern that stores the signed integer x in two's complement.
notes: −5 in 8 bits is 251 (11111011). x must lie between −2^(w−1) and 2^(w−1) − 1.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Two's Complement Decoding
description: Reads a w-bit unsigned pattern as a two's-complement signed integer.
notes: 251 in 8 bits means −5.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Integer Overflow Wrap-around
description: Gives the value a fixed-width integer actually holds when a result x overflows its range lo … hi and wraps around.
notes: 130 in a signed 8-bit integer wraps to −126.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Perfect Shuffles to Restore a Deck (Out-Shuffle)
description: Gives how many perfect riffle out-shuffles return an even-sized deck to its original order: the order of 2 modulo n − 1.
notes: A 52-card deck needs 8.

cat: Number puzzles, binary and check digits
name: Expected Position of the First Special Card
description: Gives the expected position of the first of K special cards in a shuffled deck of N.
notes: The first ace is expected at card 10.6.
